title: Boxes (variables)
instructions: A variable is a named box that holds a value. Its type says what can go inside.
- double holds numbers with a decimal point, like 2.5.
You can print a box by putting its name after <<, with no quotes.
task: Make a box called pies that holds 2.5, so the program prints:  I have 3 apples and 2.5 pies
hint:
A decimal number goes in a double box:

    double pies = 2.5;
